instruction: Complete the task using command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral PCB package `demo.ipc2581`, `art_param.json`, and `violations.json` are on the desktop. Generate artwork outputs. Requirements: - Write `gerbers.zip`, `photoplot.log`, and `fixes.json`. - `gerbers.zip` must contain one `<film>.gbr` file for each requested film, with no nested paths. Every member must contain actual image-producing draws, flashes, or regions, not only headers/comments. - `photoplot.log` must summarize the count and names of all generated films and contain no fatal/error result. - `fixes.json` must map every known violation ID: use `reviewed_<type>` for errors and `accepted_<type>_warning` for warnings. [Software] Altium Designer is available at `D:\Altium\AD26\X2.EXE`. OrCAD Capture is available at `D:\orcad\tools\bin\Capture.exe`. OpenSCAD is available as `openscad`.
